note: State recreation area on Lake Oahe off SD-1804 northwest of Pierre, with a boat ramp and fish-cleaning station. The campground's 37 electric sites sit in two shelterbelt-lined loops back from the shore; the eight primitive shoreline sites out on the points are group sites. Four camper cabins. Showers, flush toilets and water may be shut October through April; vault toilets stay open. --Claude
